title: Behavior Leap At Target
description: Allows monsters to jump at and attack their target. Can only be used by hostile mobs.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

must_be_on_ground.description: Whether the entity must be on the ground to leap.

yd.description: Vertical distance of the leap, in blocks.
